name: Efficient Compressive Neural Representation (ECNR)
definition: An INR-based compression method for time-varying volumetric datasets that replaces a single large global MLP with multiple small local MLPs to fit disjoint clusters of spatiotemporal blocks.
summary: ECNR compresses time-varying volumes using multiple local MLPs instead of one global network, achieving faster encoding and decoding speeds while maintaining high reconstruction quality.
